arxiv-2102-00190.title: Golod and tight 3-manifolds
arxiv-2102-00190.creator: Kouyemon Iriye, Daisuke Kishimoto
arxiv-2102-00190.description: Abstract . The notions Golodness and tightness for simplicial complexes come from algebra and geometry, respectively. We prove these two notions are equivalent for 3-manifold triangulations, through a topological characterization of a polyhedral product for a tight-neighborly manifold triangulation of dimension ≥ 3 \geq 3 . 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 57Q15, Secondary 13F55, 55U10 1.

arxiv-2201-07663.title: Exceptional Point Generated Robust Asymmetric High-Order Harmonics
arxiv-2201-07663.creator: Gui-Lei Zhu 1, Amir Targholizadeh 1, Xin-You Lü 2, Cem Yuce 3, Hamidreza Ramezani 1
arxiv-2201-07663.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gui-Lei Zhu 1, Amir Targholizadeh 1, Xin-You Lü 2, Cem Yuce 3, Hamidreza Ramezani 1. We propose a metallic-silicon system with a complex optical potential modulated along the length of the waveguide for a robust higher harmonic generation. For right moving fields when the strength of non-Hermiticity becomes equal to the real part of the optical potential, the dynamical equations associated with modal field amplitudes in our proposed system are described by a Jordan form Hamiltonian.

arxiv-2203-05021.title: LSTM-driven Forecast of CO 2 Injection in Porous Media
arxiv-2203-05021.creator: Gerald Kelechi Ekechukwu, Romain de Loubens, Mauricio Araya-Polo
arxiv-2203-05021.description: Abstract The ability to simulate the partial differential equations (PDE’s) that govern multi-phase flow in porous media is essential for different applications such as geologic sequestration of CO 2 , groundwater flow monitoring and hydrocarbon recovery from geologic formations [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2208-00609.title: Accurate Polygonal Mapping of Buildings in Satellite Imagery
arxiv-2208-00609.creator: Bowen Xu, Jiakun Xu, Nan Xue, Gui-Song Xia
arxiv-2208-00609.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Bowen Xu, Jiakun Xu, Nan Xue, Gui-Song Xia. This paper studies the problem of polygonal mapping of buildings by tackling the issue of mask reversibility that leads to a notable performance gap between the predicted masks and polygons from the learning-based methods.

arxiv-2303-07963.title: RoCNet: 3D robust registration of point clouds using deep learning
arxiv-2303-07963.creator: Karim Slimani, Catherine Achard, Brahim Tamadazte
arxiv-2303-07963.description: Abstract This paper introduces a new method for 3D point cloud registration based on deep learning. The architecture is composed of three distinct blocs: ( i ) an encoder with a convolutional graph-based descriptor that encodes the immediate neighbourhood of each point and an attention mechanism that encodes the variations of the surface normals.

arxiv-2308-09423.title: Overconvergent prismatic cohomology
arxiv-2308-09423.creator: Andreas Langer
arxiv-2308-09423.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Andreas Langer. In this note I define an overconvergent version of prisms and prismatic cohomology as introduced by Bhatt and Scholze and show that overconvergent prismatic cohomology specialises to p p -adic cohomologies, like Monsky-Washnitzer resp. rigid cohomology for smooth varieties over a perfect field, the de Rham cohomology of smooth weak formal schemes over a perfectoid ring and the étale cohomology of its generic fibre.

arxiv-2405-14881.title: DiffuseMix : Label-Preserving Data Augmentation with Diffusion Models
arxiv-2405-14881.creator: Khawar Islam, Muhammad Zaigham Zaheer, Arif Mahmood, Karthik Nandakumar
arxiv-2405-14881.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Khawar Islam, Muhammad Zaigham Zaheer, Arif Mahmood, Karthik Nandakumar. Recently, a number of image-mixing-based augmentation techniques have been introduced to improve the generalization of deep neural networks. In these techniques, two or more randomly selected natural images are mixed together to generate an augmented image. Such methods may not only omit important portions of the input images but also introduce label ambiguities by mixing images across labels resulting in misleading supervisory signals.

arxiv-2506-13631.title: Anomalous Superfluid Density in Pair-Density-Wave Superconductors
arxiv-2506-13631.creator: Ke Wang, Qijin Chen, Rufus Boyack, K. Levin
arxiv-2506-13631.description: Abstract We study the superfluid density n s ​ ( T ) n_{s}(T) of pair-density-wave (PDW) superconductors; this determines where they are unstable and establishes signatures of their unusual order. Here we compute n s ​ ( T ) n_{s}(T) for the 2D unidirectional PDW superconducting phases that emerge from a microscopic model (with nearest neighbor attraction).

arxiv-2509-03927.title: Groups of finite type: classification and structural properties Thanks: The author is supported by Grigorchuk’s Simons Foundation Grant MP-TSM-00002045 and the department of Mathematics of Texas A&M University.
arxiv-2509-03927.creator: Santiago Radi
arxiv-2509-03927.description: Abstract . Groups of finite type (also called finitely constrained groups), introduced by Grigorchuk, are known to be the closure of regular branch groups. This article explores many of their properties. Firstly, we prove that being finitely generated, just-infinite and strongly complete are equivalent in a vast family of groups of finite type.

arxiv-2601-04190.title: Solar Panel-based Visible Light Communication for Batteryless Systems
arxiv-2601-04190.creator: Juan F. Gutiérrez, Nhung Nguyen, Jesús M. Quintero, Andres Gomez
arxiv-2601-04190.description: Abstract This paper presents a batteryless wireless communication node for the Internet of Things, powered entirely by ambient light and capable of receiving data through visible light communication. A solar panel serves dual functions as an energy harvester and an optical antenna, capturing modulated signals from LED light sources.

pmc-10636172.title: E-DPNCT: an enhanced attack resilient differential privacy model for smart grids using split noise cancellation
pmc-10636172.creator: Khadija Hafeez, Donna O’Shea, Thomas Newe, Mubashir Husain Rehmani
pmc-10636172.description: High frequency reporting of energy consumption data in smart grids can be used to infer sensitive information regarding the consumer’s life style and poses serious security and privacy threats. Differential privacy (DP) based privacy models for smart grids ensure privacy when analysing energy consumption data for billing and load monitoring.

pmc-11352114.title: Modulating the Release Kinetics of Natural Product Actinomycin from Bacterial Nanocellulose Films and Their Antimicrobial Activity
pmc-11352114.creator: Katarzyna Zimowska, Vuk Filipovic, Jasmina Nikodinovic-Runic, Jelena Simic, Tatjana Ilic-Tomic, Malgorzata Zimowska, Jacek Gurgul, Marijana Ponjavic
pmc-11352114.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The present study aimed to create a more sustainable and controlled delivery system based on natural biopolymer bacterial nanocellulose (BNC) and bacterial natural product actinomycin (Act), with the applicative potential in the biomedical field. In order to provide improved interaction between BNC and the active compound, and thus to modulate the release kinetics, the TEMPO oxidation of BNC support was carried out.

pmc-11420507.title: Nontraumatic popliteal pseudoaneurysm: A rare entity with different etiologies
pmc-11420507.creator: Angel Galindo, Ferran Pla Sanchez, Rosa Lopez Perez, Efren Martel Almeida, Serguei de Varona Frolov, Guido Volo Perez
pmc-11420507.description: Pseudoaneurysms of the popliteal artery represent a rare vascular pathology. Leaving aside traumatic antecedents, in the presence of sudden swelling of the popliteal region, it is useful to suspect this entity, especially in the presence of infectious processes or connective tissue disorders. We present two cases from our institution where management included surgical intervention and control of the underlying diseases.

pmc-12415108.title: Enhancing Antifungal Efficacy and Stability of Nystatin Liposomes Through Chitosan and Alginate Layer-by-Layer Coating: In vitro Studies Against Candida albicans
pmc-12415108.creator: Evi Sulastri, Maya Nurul Rahma, Yedi Herdiana, Khaled M Elamin, Ahmed Fouad Abdelwahab Mohammed, Safwat A Mahmoud, Nasrul Wathoni
pmc-12415108.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundCandidiasis, predominantly caused by Candida albicans, poses a significant global health challenge, especially in tropical regions. Nystatin is a potent antifungal agent that is hindered by its low solubility and permeability, limiting its clinical efficacy.MethodsThis study aimed to investigate the potential of a layer-by-layer (LBL) coating system, employing chitosan and alginate, to improve the stability, entrapment efficiency (%EE), and antifungal efficacy of nystatin-loaded liposomes against Candida albicans.

pmc-12533158.title: Backtracking metabolic dynamics in single cells predicts bacterial replication in human macrophages
pmc-12533158.creator: Mariatou Dramé, Francisco-Javier Garcia-Rodriguez, Dmitry Ershov, Jessica E Martyn, Jean-Yves Tinevez, Carmen Buchrieser, Pedro Escoll
pmc-12533158.description: Accurately tracking dynamic state transitions is crucial for modeling and predicting biological outcomes, as it captures heterogeneity of cellular responses. To build a model to predict bacterial infection in single cells, we have monitored in parallel infection progression and metabolic parameters in thousands of human primary macrophages infected with the intracellular pathogen Legionella pneumophila.

pmc-12742163.title: Effect of qigong on sleep quality and hyperarousal in patients with chronic insomnia: a study protocol for a multi-centre randomised controlled trial
pmc-12742163.creator: Jiahe Cui, Haotian Han, Hongyu Yue, Chaoqun Xie, Jianwen Ma, Fangfang Xie, Yan-li You, Fei Yao
pmc-12742163.description: IntroductionChronic insomnia is a pressing public health issue that significantly affects patients’ quality of life. In China, Prolong Life With Nine Turn-Method (PLWNT) Qigong exercise has long been used to improve sleep quality, yet evidence that supports its efficacy for chronic insomnia treatment remains lacking.

pmc-13166650.title: Landscape and trends in postoperative cognitive dysfunction: A bibliometric and visualized analysis
pmc-13166650.creator: Wei Gan, Qiaoning Li, Jinchun Xie, Liye Liu
pmc-13166650.description: Background:Postoperative cognitive dysfunction (POCD) is a hot research topic in the field of anesthesia. Despite decades of research, its pathogenesis remains complex, and worldwide research trends are unclear. We intended to analyze the relevant researches on POCD in the past 30 years by using bibliometric methods.

pmc-13244563.title: DARIP Technique: A Novel Approach in the Surgical Management of Placenta Accreta Spectrum in the Second Trimester From Tu Du Hospital, Vietnam
pmc-13244563.creator: Ngoc Hai Tran, Phuc Nhon Nguyen, Van Hoang Bui
pmc-13244563.description: BackgroundPlacenta accreta spectrum (PAS) is an increasingly common complication during pregnancy that has led to high maternal mortality and morbidity in the past decades. Treatment of PAS in the second‐trimester pregnancy includes expectant management and surgical intervention. However, PAS surgery is related to complex obstetric management involving psychological issues and life‐threatening hemorrhage.

pmc-13263159.title: Clinical Efficacy of Revascularization Surgery for Moyamoya Angiopathy: Long‐Term Results of a European Cohort
pmc-13263159.creator: Robert Mertens, Ibrahim Efe, Friedrich Mrosk, Kristin Lucia, Mohammad Asif Iqbal, Kerstin Rubarth, Lukas Mödl, Erin Dirk Sprünken, Lucius Fekonja, Güliz Acker, Peter Vajkoczy
pmc-13263159.description: BackgroundMoyamoya angiopathy (MMA) is a cerebrovascular disease treated by surgical revascularization. This study aimed to present long‐term outcomes of European MMA patients after surgical revascularization.MethodsMMA patients treated surgically between 1998 to 2023 were included. Follow‐up comprised clinical and radiological examinations and electronic questionnaires. Patient data were analyzed retrospectively, and logistic regressions were performed to identify predictors of unfavorable outcomes.

pmc-13331520.title: Non-Factor Therapies in Haemophilia: The Era of Factor VIII Mimetics and Targeted Rebalancing Agents
pmc-13331520.creator: Lukas Graf
pmc-13331520.description: BackgroundNon-factor therapies have substantially reshaped the treatment landscape of haemophilia by restoring effective thrombin generation independently of factor replacement. By targeting key regulatory mechanisms of coagulation, these approaches address limitations of conventional therapy, including intravenous administration, fluctuating factor levels, and inhibitor development.

pmc-13462231.title: Serum Metabolite Profiling Reveals Inflammation-associated Biomarkers In Ventilator-associated Pneumonia Patients
pmc-13462231.creator: Ajay K Gautam, Rahul Yadav, Bikram K Gupta, Nidhi Tiwari, Himanshu Bhushan, Chandan Singh
pmc-13462231.description: IntroductionVentilator-associated pneumonia (VAP) is a significant healthcare-associated infection occurring in patients after at least 48 hours of mechanical ventilation in the intensive care unit (ICU). It is associated with high mortality rates, reported up to 43%, and poses diagnostic challenges due to the nonspecific clinical and radiological indicators.

pmc-13572170.creator: Afonso Cesar Lelis Brandão, Reginaldo Arakaki, Leandro Augusto da Silva
pmc-13572170.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Method highlights•Two-stage method that models PBL ecosystems and evolves them into Digital Twin supervision architectures.•Integration of RM-ODP viewpoints with event-driven observability and Complex Event Processing.•Reusable architecture for continuous evidence collection and sprint-window supervision signals in PBL environments.Keywords: Digital twin, Project-based learning, Complex event processing, Learning analytics, Repository evidence, Data contracts, Process observability Specifications table: Subject areaComputer ScienceMore specific subject areaSoftware Engineering Education; Learning Analytics; Digital Twin ArchitectureName of your methodRM-ODP-based PBL Digital Twin Modeling MethodName and reference of original methodRM-ODP (ISO/IEC 10,746)

pmc-13635453.title: A Retrospective Post-Marketing Surveillance Study on TGlobulin25®, the First Rabbit Anti-Thymocyte Globulin (r-ATG) Biosimilar Worldwide, as Induction Therapy in Adult Kidney Transplant Recipients
pmc-13635453.creator: Mojtaba Shafiekhani, Mohammad Amin Jafarzadeh, Farbod Shahabinezhad, Siavash Gholami, Jamshid Roozbeh, Zahra Zare, Sahand Mohammadzadeh, Marziyeh Doostfatemeh, Saman Nikeghbalian
pmc-13635453.description: BackgroundPost-marketing surveillance studies are essential to establish a realistic assessment of TGlobulin25®, the first rabbit anti-thymocyte globulin (rATG) biosimilar approved in Iran, for the prevention of acute kidney transplant rejection. This study aimed to conduct a post-marketing surveillance investigation comparing TGlobulin25® with the originator product regarding efficacy and safety in adult kidney transplant recipients.
